Monica —

Thanks for sending the draft. We had procurement and legal review the MSA + Order Form and pushed a handful of redlines on the commercial appendix. High-level items:
- Nimble needs net60 payment terms on invoices (we can discuss acceleration for early payments).
- We redlined a 12-month minimum commit; our preference is a phased ladder: 30% upfront, 35% at 6 months, 35% at 12 months.
- Tax: we require Redwood to accept responsibility for withholding VAT in EU markets or provide VAT evidence.
- Invoicing: procurement requires PO number on each invoice and the invoice remit address to match the PO.

I've attached the redlined Order Form (v3). Can we get a short mutual action plan and an updated OF that reflects any compromises? Procurement would like to target signature by May 6.

Best,
Sarah

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Attachments: RFQ_legal_redline_comments.pdf (pdf)

Monica / team —

I reviewed Nimble's redlines and put comments into RFQ_legal_redline_comments.pdf. Summary and recommended positions:
- Minimum commit: Accept a phased ladder but we should add (i) a minimum effective committed spend floor expressed in USD so currency fluctuation/usage doesn't leave exposure, and (ii) an early-termination true-up clause if they under-deliver usage by >25% over 12 months.
- Payment terms: Push back to Net45. Net60 creates cashflow risk. For enterprise customers who require Net60, require an approved credit application and a security deposit or letter of credit for the first tranche.
- VAT / taxes: Redwood can provide registration numbers and a tax evidence package; we will not take open liability for client's VAT unless agreed in regional SOW (we can offer to gross-up for EU VAT but that must be explicitly negotiated and priced).
- Invoicing: Include required invoice fields (PO number, remit address, Redwood legal entity), and require PO within 10 business days prior to first invoice to avoid hold.

Proposed language snippets (short):
- "Payment Terms: Customer shall pay invoices within forty-five (45) days net from the invoice date; Customer may request Net60 only upon credit approval and receipt of security deposit equal to the first invoice."
- "Minimum Commitment: Customer commits to an annual minimum spend of USD X; payments are due per the schedule in the Order Form. Failure to meet minimums triggers a true-up paid within thirty (30) days of calculation."

If you want, I can draft a v4 Order Form with these changes and mark up the MSA where necessary.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

I'll prepare a short finance checklist for Nimble (PO required fields, remit address, bank wiring instructions, tax IDs) and drop it into the Drive link Monica created.

Sarah / Michael —

Thanks for the redlines. We pulled Legal and Finance into a quick review and propose the following compromise for the Order Form (v4 attached):
1) Minimum commit (phased): 50% invoice on signature, 25% at 6 months, 25% at 12 months. We added a USD-denominated annual minimum to avoid FX exposure and a 30-day true-up for shortfalls.
2) Payment terms: Net45 standard. Net60 available only after credit approval and receipt of a security deposit equal to the first tranche.
3) Invoicing: Redwood will include the required PO number on each invoice. Please confirm the exact remit address and the PO reference format.
4) Taxes: Redwood will provide W-9 (US) and EU VAT registration numbers in the attached workbook. We will not assume open VAT withholding liability — if Nimble requires Redwood to gross-up for VAT, we need to document the scope and price accordingly.

Next steps / timeline:
- If you can confirm acceptance of the above by Apr 27, Legal will issue the v4 clean Order Form and route for signature (DocuSign link to follow).
- Procurement to provide a PO (if procurement requires Net60, please also send credit application contact so we can fast-track approvals).

Drive (read/edit): https://drive.redwood.com/contract/NIMBLE-4821
Draft DocuSign to follow based on your confirmation.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
